system_overview: plant-watering-coach is a houseplant watering schedule coach with photo health checks. It is built as a small focused system with Schedule Engine at its core, supported by Photo Health Scorer (CV) and Nudge Sender.

recommended_language.rationale: Python fits the houseplant watering schedule coach with photo health checks workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Schedule Engine as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The houseplant watering schedule coach with photo health checks hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Nudge Sender asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Plant, WateringEvent, HealthCheck must persist relationally
Components: Schedule Engine, Photo Health Scorer (CV), Nudge Sender
